    pts={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2}
    comps=[]
    while pts:
        seed=min(pts); todo=[seed]; comp=set()
        while todo:

            pts.remove(p); comp.add(p)
            r,c=p
